chats.answer:
For outdoor movie nights, I'd prioritize brightness, built-in streaming, portability, and easy setup over 4K resolution alone.

My top choices are from Anker Nebula, XGIMI, and Epson. The best one depends on whether you're watching in a backyard after sunset, taking it camping, or trying to get a really big, bright picture.

One important consideration: even an expensive portable projector generally won't look great outdoors before sunset. For a 100–150-inch outdoor screen, brightness matters a lot.
